# Go2 bridge dependency and interface references

The private bridge does not copy the public Go2 simulator or its policy/model assets. It uses public ROS/DDS interfaces and independently declares the two standard geometry message layouts needed for Twist publication.

- Eclipse Cyclone DDS Python **0.10.2**, public `DataWriter.write(sample, timestamp=...)`, `Listener.on_publication_matched` and IDL API. Its source header permits EPL-2.0 **or BSD-3-Clause**; this integration selects the BSD-3-Clause option. Preserve the dependency's distributed notices in images/packages. Pinned source: https://github.com/eclipse-cyclonedds/cyclonedds-python/tree/0.10.2 . Publication implementation: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eclipse-cyclonedds/cyclonedds-python/0.10.2/cyclonedds/pub.py . Copyright 2021–2022 ZettaScale Technology and others, as recorded by upstream.
- Eclipse Cyclone DDS C library as supplied by ROS Humble. `dds_write_ts` accepts the caller's immutable source timestamp. Its own distribution license/notice files remain applicable. Public API: https://cyclonedds.io/docs/cyclonedds/latest/api/pub.html . No private RMW object-layout access is used.
- ROS 2 `geometry_msgs` Vector3/Twist interface shapes and standard ROS DDS topic/type naming. ROS common interfaces are Apache-2.0. Source: https://github.com/ros2/common_interfaces/tree/humble/geometry_msgs . The bridge's declarations contain three float64 Vector3 members and the standard linear/angular Twist members; they do not copy generated simulator code.
- ROS Humble `rmw_cyclonedds_cpp` passes DDS source timestamps through to subscriber metadata. Apache-2.0 source: https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/blob/humble/rmw_cyclonedds_cpp/src/rmw_node.cpp . This branch link explains interoperability and is not an immutable artifact pin; the actual dependency image digest and package inventory must be retained with runtime evidence.
- Existing Wendy Go2 command policy audited read-only at public commit **33f42d865fe6681f16669a430242a60bed0a7e5d**, in `go/simulator/go2/go2_sim/{commands,native_commands,simulation,runtime,ros,slow_sensors}.py` and `ros_ws/src/go2_command_ingress/src/command_ingress.cpp`. The existing runtime's notices continue to govern that separately deployed runtime.

No production PKI, hardware authority, simulator redistributability conclusion or certification follows from this dependency inventory.
